solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Tasteful melody in the woodwind

indicators.note: the melody is set inside the instrument, as the clue says the tune is in the woodwind

parts.note: a reed is a woodwind instrument (or its vibrating part)
a strain is a passage of melody

explanation.surface: A tasteful tune played on a clarinet or oboe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tasteful' reads as praise for the tune, but it is the definition: restrained taste avoids excess.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something tasteful is understated and held back, not showy.

clue.text: Painter makes small change in deer

indicators.note: the small coin is placed inside the deer word, as the clue says change in deer

parts.note: a roe is a small deer
P stands for penny, a small coin

explanation.surface: An artist makes a minor alteration to a picture of a deer.
explanation.walkthrough: A painter is not an artist here but a line on a boat's bow for tying it up.
explanation.definitionFit: Nautical sense: a painter is the line attached to a small boat's bow for mooring it.

clue.text: Without resistance mole is nimble

indicators.note: used in its old sense of outside: the mole word goes around the resistance letter

parts.note: a mole is a spy planted in an organisation
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A burrowing animal moves nimbly with nothing holding it back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' looks like a deletion signal, but it means outside: SPY goes around R.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: spry describes someone active and lively, especially an older person.

clue.text: Fear hooter is ill-fitted to make lots of noise

indicators.note: badly put together, so the letters of the preceding words are reassembled

explanation.surface: Fear that a badly fitted car horn will be very loud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' belongs to the fodder, not a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to cheer or shout so loudly the building seems to lift, i.e. be very loud.

clue.text: Children matter

definitions.meaning: a topic or point under discussion

explanation.surface: Children are important.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: legal word for offspring, and a subject or question under debate.

clue.text: Fugitive union member has internal operation

indicators.note: the member word holds the operation abbreviation inside itself

parts.note: an element is a member or component of a set

explanation.surface: A trade-union member on the run is having surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'union' suggests a trade union, but the definition means a marriage made by running away.
explanation.definitionFit: A runaway marriage: couples who elope flee to wed in secret.

clue.text: Avoid head of state with vandal

indicators.note: the first letter of the following word is taken

parts.note: the Huns, like the Vandals, were barbarian invaders of Rome; a hun is a destroyer

explanation.surface: Keep away from a national leader who goes about with a hooligan.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to shun someone is to keep away from them deliberately.

clue.text: Trial by one in promotion of audio device

parts.note: a court hearing is a trial of a case

indicators.note: the numeral for one is placed inside the promotion word

parts.note: an ad promotes a product
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A test by one person while advertising a sound gadget.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a hearing aid is a small electronic device that amplifies sound for the hard of hearing.

clue.text: Without resistance English invaders arrive in exclusion zone

indicators.note: here meaning lacking, so the resistance letter is dropped from the invaders

parts.note: the Normans invaded England in 1066
R is the symbol for electrical resistance
to land is to arrive, as a plane does

explanation.surface: Invaders of England arrive unopposed in a forbidden area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' here removes: NORMANS loses R to give NOMANS.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the strip between front lines that nobody may enter, hence any forbidden zone.

clue.text: US politician returning to duty gets agreement

indicators.note: going back, so the politician's abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: Rep. is short for a US Representative
a mission is an assigned task or duty

explanation.surface: An American congressman back at work wins consent.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: permission is consent, an agreement to let something happen.

clue.text: Rich with power

parts.note: arm means power or might, as in the long arm of the law

explanation.surface: Wealthy and powerful.
explanation.definitionFit: Of colours or tones, rich and warm both mean deep and glowing.

clue.text: Sick during plane trip at dusk

indicators.note: one thing occurring within another, so the sickness word goes inside the trip word

parts.note: a flight is a trip by plane
ailing means unwell

explanation.surface: Feeling ill on an evening flight.
explanation.definitionFit: Paraphrase: at the end of the day daylight fades, which is what dusk is.

clue.text: Worsening state of French breeding

parts.note: de is French for of
generation is the producing of offspring

explanation.surface: The decline of French pedigree livestock.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: degeneration is a decline, a process or state of getting worse.

clue.text: Diet Claude worked out and explained

indicators.note: solved or reshaped, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Claude devised a diet and described it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to elucidate is to make clear, so elucidated means made clear.

clue.text: Only one beau's getting lucky

parts.note: just means only, as in just one
A means one
a swell or beau is a fashionable dandy

explanation.surface: A single boyfriend gets fortunate.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: it is just as well means it is fortunate or a good thing.

clue.text: A huge ball exploded? That's very funny!

indicators.note: blown apart, so the letters of the phrase are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A giant ball bursting is hilarious.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something laughable is ridiculous enough to laugh at.

clue.text: Royal guard initially executes exploit when in drink

indicators.note: the exploit and the letter go inside the drink word

parts.note: beer is a drink
a feat is a daring exploit

indicators.note: the first letter of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: A palace guard performs a stunt while drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: The exploit comes before the initial letter of 'executes' inside the drink, though the clue names them the other way round.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Beefeaters are the Yeoman Warders guarding the Tower of London, a royal fortress.

clue.text: This is allowed on a lake

parts.note: in cricket the on side is also called the leg side
L is an abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: Something permitted on a lake, such as boating.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the leg side is the half of the field behind the batter's legs, also called the on side.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something legal is permitted by law.

clue.text: Supply a note when in credit

indicators.note: the letters go inside the credit abbreviation

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Provide a banknote when your account is in the black.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to cater is to provide food or what is needed.

clue.text: Development in old dispute

parts.note: ex- means former, as in ex-wife
tension is strain or conflict between parties

explanation.surface: A new turn in a long-running quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an extension is an enlargement or growth of something existing.

clue.text: Cripple protects refuge that can be found

indicators.note: wraps around and shields, so the cripple word goes around the refuge word

parts.note: to disable is to cripple
cover is shelter or a hiding place

explanation.surface: Something disabling guards a shelter that could be located.
explanation.definitionFit: Paraphrase: discoverable means able to be detected or located.

clue.text: A desire to be with you

parts.note: to long is to desire or yearn

explanation.surface: A yearning to be in someone's company.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage: along means in company, as in 'I'll come along' to be with someone.

clue.text: Prohibit new building

parts.note: to bar is to prohibit

explanation.surface: A ban on new construction.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a barn is a farm building for storing crops or housing animals.

clue.text: Convey old Bob's demise

parts.note: a bob was the old British shilling, abbreviated s
an end is a death or demise

explanation.surface: Report the death of an old man named Bob.
explanation.walkthrough: Bob is not a name: it is slang for a shilling, an old British coin worth 5p, written s.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to send something is to convey or dispatch it.

clue.text: One who drew level

definitions.meaning: a person who ties, drawing a match with an equal score
a layer or rank, as in a wedding cake's layers

explanation.surface: Someone who equalised the score.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a person who ties a contest, and a row or rank in a stacked series.

clue.text: Anglers got bad weather

indicators.note: spoilt or wrong, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fishermen were caught in a storm.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a strong gale is a category of very windy weather on the Beaufort scale.

clue.text: Herb made Penny unwell

parts.note: d was the abbreviation for the old British penny
ill means unwell

explanation.surface: A woman named Penny was made sick by a plant.
explanation.walkthrough: Penny is not a name: d was the symbol of the old British penny.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: dill is a feathery aromatic herb used with fish and pickles.

clue.text: Immediately entering marsh journalist gets panicky

indicators.note: going into, so the immediacy word is placed inside the marsh word

parts.note: a fen is a marsh
right means immediately, as in right now
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A reporter wading straight into a bog becomes alarmed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone panicky is scared and anxious.
